title: HackerRank: Sherlock and Anagrams
description: Two strings are anagrams of each other if the letters of one string can be rearranged to form the other. Given a string `s`, find the number of unordered pairs of substrings of `s` that are anagrams of each other.
constraints:
2 <= len(s) <= 100
• Time: O(N^2 log K) | Space: O(N^2)
explanation: Canonical sorted substring hashing counts matching anagram pairs using combination formula v*(v-1)//2 in O(N^2) time.
